title: Multi-level structural modulation enables fast lithium-ion transport in inorganic solid-state batteries
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00895F, Review Article
Tianpeng Huang, Yue Zheng, Deye Sun, Jun Ma, Pengxian Han, Guanglei Cui
This review focuses on the short-range and long-range charge transport processes in solid-state lithium metal batteries and their correlation between multi-level structural modulation at electrode, electrolyte, and battery levels.
